Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music | National | Top Story Hitz-Joy Beach Rave gets underway at Rehab Beach Club with star-studded line-up Source : Emmanuel Tetteh 31 October 2026 7:29pm Audio By Carbonatix
The much-anticipated Hitz-Joy Beach Rave is underway at Rehab Beach Club in Labadi, Accra, bringing together music lovers, entertainment enthusiasts and some of Ghana's biggest musical talents for an afternoon and evening of music, dancing and beachside fun.
The event, jointly organised by Hitz 103.9 FM and Joy 99.7 FM, both part of the Multimedia Group, features 19 performers from Ghana's entertainment industry.
Leading the star-studded line-up are award-winning musicians King Promise and KiDi, alongside dancehall and reggae sensation Ras Kuuku, Morgan Nero and music duo Lali X Lola.
The DJ line-up includes Merqury Quaye, Andy Dosty, DJ Raennie, DJ Fantastic, DJ Dhon K, DJ Shaker HD, DJ Ikon and DJ Wobeti, among others.
With a mixture of Afrobeats, highlife, dancehall and contemporary Ghanaian sounds, the beach rave is designed to give patrons an opportunity to unwind and enjoy live entertainment in a vibrant coastal setting.
Beyond the musical performances, the event features DJ sessions, games and other beachside activities, offering a complete entertainment experience for young people and music enthusiasts.
As the celebration continues at Rehab Beach Club, patrons are set for an exciting blend of music, beach culture and Ghanaian entertainment.
